commands.review_summary:
The branch extends the stacked Policy doctor repair series by classifying denied Gateway HTTP endpoint findings as automatic and adding opt-in `doctor --fix` config mutation, tests, and docs.

PR surface: Source +1085, Tests +689, Docs +32, Other +8. Total +1814 across 19 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the review finding: source inspection shows quoted ocPath segments can be emitted for arbitrary config keys, while the PR parser splits on `/` before decoding quoted segments. I did not run tests because this review is read-only.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Protected `maintainer` label, draft stacked status, security-boundary acceptance, missing real behavior proof, and the parser finding require contributor or maintainer handling rather than an autonomous cleanup close.

target.title: policy: repair denied gateway http endpoints
target.body:
## Summary  - Stack on #99720 to add the next policy doctor repair slice. - Classify `policy/gateway-http-endpoint-enabled` as an automatic narrowing repair. - Wire `doctor --fix` to set exact reported denied Gateway HTTP endpoint `enabled` paths to `false`. - Leave URL-fetch allowlist findings manual; this PR only disables denied endpoints and preserves nested endpoint config.  ## Validation  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts --reporter=dot` (293 tests) - `pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/gateway.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/fix-metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts` - `pnpm exec oxlint extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/gateway.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/fix-metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts` - `pnpm tsgo:extensions` - `git diff --check` - `codex review --base origin/policy-doctor-channel-ingress-repairs` (clean)  ## Stack  - Stacked on #99720 / #99700 / #99690 / #99686 / #99121. - Review after #99720, then rebase onto `main` as the lower stack lands.  ## Not Run  - `pnpm tsgo:core` remains locally blocked by unrelated untracked `src/oc-path/` unused-symbol errors in this worktree.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
`doctor --fix` repairs denied Gateway HTTP endpoint findings by setting the reported endpoint `enabled` path to `false` while preserving nested endpoint config, with URL-fetch allowlist findings left manual.

Real environment tested:
Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-fork` on the restacked policy series, top head `283c1bb4ca` and this PR head `6edfe6f698`. This is a source-harness proof; it does not start a packaged OpenClaw binary or make live LLM calls.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts --reporter=dot`
2. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter=dot`
3. `pnpm tsgo:extensions`
4. `pnpm lint:extensions`
5. `git diff --check`

Evidence after fix:
The focused policy/core Vitest run passed 10 core repair-flow tests and 297 policy doctor tests, including `repairs denied gateway HTTP endpoint findings`. The SDK surface tooling test passed 7 tests. `tsgo:extensions`, `lint:extensions`, and `git diff --check` all exited 0.

Observed result after fix:
Denied Gateway HTTP endpoint repair disables only the reported endpoint path and does not rewrite nested URL-fetch options.

What was not tested:
No packaged CLI smoke, live provider run, or live LLM call was run for this source-harness proof.
